description: Detailed drawings including sections, and method statements where applicable; of the railings, balconies, gate showing traditional detail of hinges- each type showing location and giving key details with adjacent fabric, details of new rear infill extension including new external doors, and roof glazing showing details of materiality and key junctions with existing fabric, external staircase, ladders reflected ceiling plans showing light fittings etc and coordinated integrated services, indicating new or retained existing ceiling constructions, a method statement further to investigative works for removal of modern ceilings and reinstatement of historic ceilings if applicable, must be included, details of existing and proposed floor build ups further to investigative works, cross referred on plans, details of sample photos showing materiality and technical specifications of any new glazing for the windows and details of sample photographs and specifications of the paving material at rear garden, infill rear extension including glazing, frames, staircase, landing pursuant to condition 4 (A), (B), (C), (G), (I), 5 & 7 of planning permission dated 12th June 2025 (RN:25/00027/FULL)
